66fb51084cb84f6fe93d.text: Summarization helps you to determine essential ideas and consolidate

db1f21d00f4a2920fe59.text: important details that support them. It also enables you to focus on key words and phrases of an assigned text that are worth noting and remembering. Thus, it teaches you how to take a large selection of text and reduce it to the main points for more concise understanding.

9f561b4daffb32138b35.text: Summary is a shortened version of a text that highlights its key points. To

a8de440f9456ab8f74cd.text: summarize is to retell a story in your own words. Writing a summary requires you to make use of your own words, make the original composition shorter, and tell only the important points in the beginning, middle and end.

8986f86a571815b09765.text: Don’t forget also the who (who are the characters), what (what did the

efded501213ae995e594.text: characters want), where (where did the story happen), when (when did the story happen), why (state the conflict) and how (how did the story end).

43467ec49bd09a6ef9fe.text: The process of writing a summary is further discussed in the following

rows: Read the material and identify the main ideas. Distinguish the main ideas from the details.
Write the main ideas in phrase form. The main ideas can be noted in a list, in a topic web, or in the left column of two-column notes.
Begin the summary with an introductory statement.
Turn the main ideas into sentences, occasionally including details when it is necessary to convey the main idea.
Combine the sentences into one or more paragraphs.
Use transition words to connect the sentences and the paragraphs.
Proofread the summary for punctuation, spelling, sentence structure, and content.
90705bdbce48cb563bd0.text: STEPS  1 Read the material and identify the main ideas. Distinguish the main ideas from the details. 2 Write the main ideas in phrase form. The main ideas can be noted in a list, in a topic web, or in the left column of two-column notes. 3 Begin the summary with an introductory statement. 4 Turn the main ideas into sentences, occasionally including details when it is necessary to convey the main idea. 5 Combine the sentences into one or more paragraphs. 6 Use transition words to connect the sentences and the paragraphs. 7 Proofread the summary for punctuation, spelling, sentence structure, and content.

34afe41f9e472b49a865.text: Use few words to tell the most important part of the story. Summaries should

202a86d4ba46e06b780c.text: be written in the third person. A summary focuses solely on the content of what you have read, never on your opinion or thoughts about the content.

5a11b79a99a9279eef8b.text: Remember, when you present a summary, you want your reader to be

2ca69a9f7fcd14ba1de2.text: confident that you are communicating only what the writer said, not your own ideas.

f014d44fd20b10bb49ee.text: Here are some rules in making a precis. A well written précis should be a

00e33a8183f57cae13d1.text: serviceable substitute for the original work. The goal of a précis is to preserve the core essence of the work in a manner that is both clear and concise. While writing a précis, the writer should follow the given rules to make it an effective piece of work.

a974059deda6c79463a3.text: 1. Attentively read the source text. You need to understand what it is about and what the author wants to emphasize. Make a list of the bullet points to always have them in front of you;

9c8b22cf4b47a9c2246b.text: 2. Highlight its main features, arguments and points. Then it will be much easier for you to concentrate on the work and stick to a proper précis format;

c5c36dad75ddccc2cb7c.text: 3. Make a list of the used evidence. This will help you will understand what the main ideas and motives of the author are. Without walking in the author’s shoes you won’t be able to create an awesome work;

e64f4a550e60822d40af.text: 4. Research any information you find unfamiliar. This includes terms, definitions, data, statements, etc. You need to have a clear understanding of what you are writing about. If you have any doubts, research the subject;

b19f27981f65c4774e8b.text: 5. Identify call-to-actions. These may become the main motives the author was trying to convey. They are usually situated in the end of the paragraph or text and urge the reader to move forward, support the author or act in any particular way. The best precis examples always contain outstanding call-to- actions;

df850fc7a94ced46988f.text: 6. Make an evaluation of how the writer showed key points of his work. This may give your readers a better understanding of the text’s meaning;

0db30cb96b747955ad1c.text: 7. Make a thesis restatement. It should also consist of one or two statements and indicate general ideas of the whole work. Your thesis is the heart of the work, so think thoroughly about how to put it into words. Don’t be in a hurry and write this section only when the whole précis is ready;

8fa0d22251877982226d.text: 8. Write a brief summary for each part of the article. It should explain its key ideas and features, and give the reader an understanding of what the source text is about;

7b3e6334f359351c8c22.text: 9. Give explanation of the piece, using your own words. Avoid being too general and never forget about your own unique style. It is important to show your personality and give a side look on seemingly common facts and ideas;

70b1185fd8479b44f5c4.text: 10. Reread the initial text and compare it to your summary. They should interlink and your précis must contain all the key features and points of the source.

e2f628c9363b0172d388.text: Let us look again at what we did in the previous exercises. We read the

d132b13811c7d39d8a5e.text: sentences and then we thought of other ways to say the sentences. We changed some words like big to enormous and little to tiny. These words are called synonyms.

8aa78ecc19c9632657e8.text: In paraphrasing, here are steps to follow: 1. Read the passage several times to fully understand the message. 2. Note down key concepts. 3. Write your version of the text without looking at the original. 4. Compare your paraphrased text with the original passage and make

92f1a17e96a4eb5b53c3.text: minor adjustments to phrases that remain too similar. 5. Cite the source where you found the idea.

64582e789a60717fea58.text: Please watch the video in order for you to fully understand what paraphrasing

reference-clarification.text: Paraphrasing changes wording and sentence structure while preserving the original meaning. Replacing only individual words with synonyms may leave the result too close to the original.
